summary: Backend: 26/26 pytest tests passed after adding coverage for xoks-carbon-plain (5 active products, image_bg='light', 3 specs, price 44.90, image reachable). Verified dark products (pro-elite/carbon-blue/stealth-ankle) still image_bg!=light. Frontend: /produtos grid confirms xoks-game & xoks-carbon-plain panels use white (#FEFEFE) bg; other 3 dark. Detail page /produto/xoks-carbon-plain shows 44,90 €, all 3 specs, size-guide-dialog opens from size-guide-btn, reviews-section present, add-to-cart works. Admin flow: new-product-btn opens product-form-dialog, pf-lightbg checked by DEFAULT, saving creates product with image_bg='light' (verified via API). Editing xoks-pro-elite shows pf-lightbg unchecked and saving without toggling preserves image_bg='dark'. Test product created via UI was deleted, baseline restored to 5.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminProducts save() sends image_bg on every PUT; that's intentional and correct. However openEdit coerces missing image_bg to 'light' via `p.image_bg === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'` — this is safe since backend seed sets explicit image_bg for all products, but if a legacy doc lacks the field it would flip to light on next save. Consider defaulting to 'dark' to match ProductBase default.
server.py: consider adding a DELETE /partnerships/{id} endpoint for cleanup consistency.
